messages:
emma (partnerships): Hey team — IdentityFlow asked about a joint go-to-market for their identity connector next month. Scope: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM key wrapping for secrets sync, and a marketplace listing. Who can take ownership of each piece? :rocket:

ajay (security): I can own the KMS/HSM checklist. Need their KMS vendor (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or on-prem HSM), key rotation policy, and attestation report. Also request their KMS API creds for a short smoke test (read-only).

lina (product): I’ll take SCIM. Ask them for a sample user payload, group mapping doc, and expected provisioning frequency. Also need a list of required vs optional attributes.

noah (eng): I’ll run SAML test flows and the edge runtime integration test. Quick wins: send their IdP metadata and a test SP metadata from our side. I can spin up a local SAML test harness. For reference: `curl -sS https://idp.identityflow.com/metadata -o idp-metadata.xml`

identityflow-sales: We can provide IdP metadata and a SCIM sandbox this week. KMS: they use a hosted HSM (KeyLedger). We can share attestation and an endpoint URL. Preferred launch window is Apr 20–24.

emma (partnerships): Good — timeline looks doable. Lina/Noah/Ajay, can you each confirm what you need from IdentityFlow by EOD Fri? I’ll own marketplace listing + marketing coordination.

ajay (security): Confirming — I need: 1) KMS vendor doc, 2) HSM attestation PDF, 3) API endpoint, 4) read-only API key. Will also schedule a short threat model call.

lina (product): Confirming — sample SCIM payload, list of groups, delta vs full sync behavior, error responses. I'll prepare a mapping doc template.

noah (eng): Confirming — IdP metadata, TLS cert thumbprint, SAML test accounts (2 users), SP metadata from our infra. I’ll also add an automated test to the nightly suite (can be toggled off).

karen (legal): Heads-up: we need to approve joint messaging and any partner logos. IdentityFlow legal should send their logo asset and brand guidelines. Also confirm embargo date if any.

identityflow-sales: Sending SCIM sandbox creds and IdP metadata today. Logo + legal copy will follow tomorrow. Embargo is Apr 20 08:00 PT.

emma (partnerships): Perfect. For the marketplace listing, I need a short blurb, logo, integration tags (SAML, SCIM, KMS), and a screenshot. I’ll draft the blurb and share for review.

release-bot: draft-pr created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-integrations/pull/412 — contains initial marketplace entry and install guide stub.

noah (eng): Quick SCIM example I'll use for tests:

```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{
  "userName": "jdoe",
  "displayName": "John Doe",
  "emails": [{"value":"jdoe@identityflow.com"}]
}
```

ajay (security): And a quick SAML metadata fetch command for IdentityFlow team:

`curl -sS -o idp.xml https://idp.identityflow.com/metadata`

emma (partnerships): Checkpoints:
- EOD Fri: vendor artifacts from IdentityFlow (IdP metadata, SCIM sample, KMS attestation)
- Next Tue: security call and SCIM mapping review
- Apr 10: internal dry run of install + docs
- Apr 20 08:00 PT: joint announcement (embargo lift)

identityflow-sales: Confirmed. We'll aim to get all artifacts by EOD Fri. Thanks everyone.

emma (partnerships): Thanks — I'll put calendar invites and a short agenda. If anything blocks, ping me or @ajay. :thumbsup:
